attempts.summary: Published node2's HTTP service (port 8080) on node1's (OPNsense) address 10.100.169.10:80 via a DNAT port-forward with NAT reflection/hairpin helper enabled, so node3 (on the same private subnet as node2) reaches the service only through node1's outward address rather than contacting node2 directly (direct access from node3 to node2:8080 is blocked by a firewalld rule that only trusts node1's IP). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and service/path recovery verified after each.
